about: Merges decided while inspecting the Hero looks (2026-11-18): the heroes are grouped by layout (frame, layout and image); their text styles are authored per hero and are left to the base variant. group.mjs applies them after grouping; merged instances keep tags for what differs.

merge.why: One group per layout: the heroes of a layout differ in their authored title and text sizes and colours, which the base variant will set.

names.full; plain | 1 per row; unit plain, pad: Image behind the text, full width
names.full; shadow | 1 per row; unit shadow, p: Image behind the text, in a box with a shadow
names.full; plain | 1 per row; unit plain, pad: Image behind the text, half width
